ui-frosted-glass.dxbc, ui-frosted-glass-image.dxbc and ui-frosted-glass-text.dxbc:
the shipped ui_frosted_glass.cg.fp (ps_5_0, 2,160 bytes),
ui_frosted_glass_image.cg.fp (ps_5_0, 2,404 bytes) and
ui_frosted_glass_text.cg.fp (ps_5_0, 3,248 bytes) pixel shaders, extracted
read-only from GRID 2's shaderpack/dx11/ui.pssg (SHA-256
e1225583f8d8c3ed7495869dc7115fed83a64cc79d128af1456c53d00b6a25d4) at byte
offsets 666464, 57815 and 1066660. Their renderer fingerprints (FNV-1a 64 of the
bytecode, as passed to CreatePixelShader) are 7899d0ed7e9690dd,
98f5a937f5cf8201 and 25d30096ffcb1ec4.

The menu cards (endgame garage car list, post-race rewards) blend
lerp(panel colour, background, FrostedGlassIntensity * 0.01), where background
samples TFrostedGlassBackground (t0, or t1 after the artwork) at the card's
position on the game's canvas plus FrostedGlassOffsetX/Y. FrostedGlassIntensity
is $Globals byte 152 (frosted glass, image; 160-byte buffer) or 168 (text;
208-byte buffer). The test renders each shader on WARP and requires the patched
draw to match the shader's own output with FrostedGlassIntensity 0 byte for
byte.

ui-bokeh-reflection.dxbc, ui-bokeh-image.dxbc and ui-bokeh-text.dxbc: the shipped
ui_bokeh_reflection.cg.fp (2,484 bytes), ui_bokeh_image.cg.fp (2,728 bytes) and
ui_bokeh_text.cg.fp (3,576 bytes) from the same ui.pssg at byte offsets 678911,
1858381 and 1744775; fingerprints 5eb4ebd096e2b07b, dc6f3d48c65d8c90 and
dcb92a30d574cfe3. They blend the max of three TBokehReflection samples at the
card's canvas position with _BokehReflectIntensity * 0.01, at the same $Globals
offsets (152, or 168 for text). The two ui_bokeh_fake_mask shaders output that
background directly with no intensity and are not patched.
